note: PLAN.md W2.6: for each attack family, which emitting metric has a positive control and a matched null, and the pre-declared metric-specific threshold. A family/metric pair without a control may not appear in a headline claim (W2.4). Built 2026-08-25 from the W2.3 emitters, the W2.4 dose-response curves, and the forward-membership falsification.

token_top1.threshold_basis: W2.4 dose-response: sharp injection onset at coverage ~0.06-0.10 across training size and frame length; +1.0 pp is the pre-declared horizontal gate line

rare_token_top1.threshold_basis: most sensitive metric (on at coverage 0.04); restricted to tokens below the 50th percentile, where a frequent-token control reads exactly 0 by construction, so raw recovery is reported alongside the advantage
rare_token_top1.control: shuffled_label null; raw_recovery_pct_by_probe accompanies every advantage (the degenerate-control flag)

token_cross_entropy.threshold_basis: proper scoring rule -- a confidently-wrong null inverts it (W2.3 s45 +21.1); read as arm minus the arm's matched null, not against the constant control
token_cross_entropy.control: per-arm matched null (grad_real vs grad_real_shuffled); the constant control is inadmissible here

membership_auc.threshold_basis: FALSIFIED as a channel 2026-08-24 (the coordinate probe's in-sample memorization, not a wire mark; OPEN_CHANNELS.md CORRECTION). Retained as a probe-generalization diagnostic only. A real membership test (train-vs-eval wire with randomized assignment) is a W2.6 open item -- no positive control exists yet
membership_auc.control: NONE -- the constant control is vacuous (any constant score gives AUC 0.5). Declared unavailable for headline use until a representation-matched control exists

forward_only.positive_control: injected_leak on the forward wire, codeword injection (W2.4)
forward_only.note: the original gate's channel; resolves at >= ~12 delegated layers

gradient_only.note: the E1 channel; structural chaff-partition leak

joint_forward_gradient.note: the family that first broke the pre-declared gate

accumulated_history.note: no control exists; KV-cache seam (S4) unmeasured

timing_metadata.note: seam S6; no leakage metric applies to control-metadata timing

active_perturbation.positive_control: amplitude sweep (W2.4) -- CE is dose-insensitive until the perturbation dominates, which is the right control for an active family

membership_property.note: no positive control. W2.6 open item: the falsified membership_auc plus property_auc (no property labels in any capture). A proper test needs randomized train/eval membership assignment

response_side.note: no response-side capture exists in the transcript protocol; unmeasured by design, not by neglect

open_items: semantic_recovery: no similarity measure chosen; must be named before freeze, and it is not constructible from the current captures
membership_property: needs randomized train/eval assignment run to disentangle membership from corpus position
accumulated_history (S4), stateful_remote_state (S6), timing_metadata (S6): no attack family or metric; recorded as unmeasured seams, not silently dropped
